method: New transcription of Wikipedia season calendars and championship result matrices. No official results-feed records or official circuit artwork are carried over. Blank cells are omitted; published championship totals are retained. Historical matrix coverage varies. MotoGP Sprint matrices contain points-scoring finishers only. No lap times, gaps or lap counts are inferred.
transformations: Transcribed calendars, results and published standings into JSON.
Merged spelling and venue-name aliases; historic and modern layouts are grouped by venue.
Unknown per-race manufacturer assignments for mixed-machine seasons are left blank.
Sprint points-scoring positions extracted separately from MotoGP GP positions.
Unpublished lap times, laps and gaps are not reconstructed.
Source tables may contain errors; counts describe this snapshot.
